name: ellmos-lock-master
description: File-based locks for mixed agent teams (Claude Code, Codex, Gemini, Kimi) in one repository or synced folder: hooks block edits and pushes covered by a foreign lock, commands set and release your own.

lease_store.title: Lease store URL (optional preview)
lease_store.description: Only for per-file leases across sessions and computers through ellmos-roshambo (not yet published): sqlite:///path/leases.db or postgresql://user:password@host/db. Leave empty to keep leases off. Stored in your system's credential store; the ELLMOS_LOCK_LEASES environment variable still works when this is empty.
